name: LEGO Powered Up City Hub (88009)
notes: LEGO Wireless Protocol 3.0 (LWP3), public spec. One message per port: Port Output Command 0x81, startup 0x11 (execute immediately, feedback), sub command WriteDirectModeData 0x51, mode 0 = power, int8 power -100..100 (0 = float). City Hub ports A = 0x00, B = 0x01. Train motor 88011 and lights 88005 both take StartPower. The hub keeps a motor running while connected (no watchdog) but stops all outputs when the BLE connection drops. A frame is several LWP3 messages back to back; byte 0 of each message is its length, the radio writes them one by one. Hub advertises service 1623 (name is user-defined, default e.g. "HUB NO.4"), so scans match by service.

encodePercent.source: LWP3 spec: Port Output Command / WriteDirectModeData StartPower
